---
name: Proof obligation or correction
about: A bounded mathematical claim, missing hypothesis, or counterexample
title: '[G1a/G1b/G1c/G1d/G2/G3/G4/G5] '
---

## Claim and status

State the precise claim and whether this is a proposal, proof, conditional result, question, or obstruction.

## Sources and assumptions

Link the producer and audit; give printed page/equation locators for imports. Specify domains, currents, gauges, cuts, normalizers, and required uniformities.

## Argument or failure test

Give the smallest checkable argument or counterexample and its scope.

## Definition of done

Identify which open-problem conditions this would close and which remain unresolved.
